title: A narrowing cast that does not fit raises under ANSI
verdict: `CAST(BIGINT AS INT)` out of range raises `CAST_OVERFLOW`
description: Under ANSI mode a cast to a narrower integer that does not fit raises `CAST_OVERFLOW`.
reference: `UnFn.narrow` raises where the value does not fit (`badCast`): Spark under ANSI raises natively.

provenance.checked_by: #1166 restatement probe (session youthful-margulis), spark 4.3.0, macOS arm64

evidence.observed: [CAST_OVERFLOW] The value 1099511627776L of the type "BIGINT" cannot be cast to "INT" due to an overflow.
